summary: GRI 405 addresses an organization's approach to diversity and equal opportunity at work. It covers the diversity of governance bodies and employees and the ratio of women's to men's basic salary and remuneration.

questions.text: Describe the actual and potential, negative and positive impacts of the organization on the economy, environment and people, including impacts on their human rights, in relation to diversity and equal opportunity.
questions.hint: Cover both actual and potential impacts, negative and positive, including impacts on human rights.

questions.text: Is the organization involved with the negative impacts related to diversity and equal opportunity through its own activities or as a result of its business relationships? Describe those activities or business relationships.
questions.hint: State whether involvement is through the organization's activities or through its business relationships, and describe them.

questions.text: Describe the organization's policies or commitments regarding diversity and equal opportunity.
questions.hint: Describe the policies or commitments that apply to this material topic.

questions.text: Describe the actions taken to manage diversity and equal opportunity and the related impacts, including (i) actions to prevent or mitigate potential negative impacts, (ii) actions to address actual negative impacts, including actions to provide for or cooperate in their remediation, and (iii) actions to manage actual and potential positive impacts.
questions.hint: Cover i. prevention or mitigation of potential negative impacts; ii. addressing actual negative impacts, including remediation; iii. managing positive impacts.

questions.text: How does the organization track the effectiveness of the actions taken? Describe (i) the processes used, (ii) the goals, targets and indicators used to evaluate progress, (iii) the effectiveness of the actions, including progress toward goals and targets, and (iv) lessons learned and how they have been incorporated into operational policies and procedures.
questions.hint: Cover i. tracking processes; ii. goals, targets and indicators; iii. effectiveness and progress; iv. lessons learned and how they were incorporated.

questions.text: Describe how engagement with stakeholders has informed the actions taken (3-3-d) and how it has informed whether the actions have been effective (3-3-e).
questions.hint: Explain the role of stakeholder engagement in shaping actions and in judging their effectiveness.

disclosures.title: Diversity of governance bodies and employees

questions.text: What percentage of individuals within the organization's governance bodies falls into each diversity category: (i) gender, (ii) age group (under 30 years old, 30-50 years old, over 50 years old), and (iii) other indicators of diversity where relevant (such as minority or vulnerable groups)?

What percentage of employees per employee category falls into each diversity category: (i) gender, (ii) age group (under 30 years old, 30-50 years old, over 50 years old), and (iii) other indicators of diversity where relevant (such as minority or vulnerable groups)?

disclosures.title: Ratio of basic salary and remuneration of women to men

questions.text: What is the ratio of the basic salary and remuneration of women to men for each employee category, by significant locations of operation?
questions.hint: Report the ratio per employee category and significant location.

questions.text: What definition is used for 'significant locations of operation'?
questions.hint: Provide the definition applied in part a.
